items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: John LaBarbara, you know, played with Buddy’s band, Sherrie and I started the band.

ctx.x: The other humorous — when we first had rehearsal, John LaBarbara, you know, played with Buddy’s band, Sherrie and I started the band. And we’re going to lay it out to them

when we picked out 15. That’s nine years — we are going to tell them where it’s at. We got 75 years of experience between the two of us, we know the rotten band leaders, we stayed in the worst hotels, we know there’s alcoholics, we know the drugs, we know everything. There’s nothing you could tell us we don’t know. And my first trumpet player, our first trumpet player, raises her hand and she says, “oh yeah, and I’m pregnant.” Well she wasn’t, but that’s the humor.
